From: Sarah Coleman <sarah.coleman@novahealth.io>

Cc: Tom Erickson <t.erickson@novahealth.io>, procure@novahealth.io
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SIG questionnaire + evidence for NovaHealth POC

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for taking the time yesterday. As we discussed, Procurement and Security at NovaHealth need a completed SIG questionnaire and supporting evidence to move the POC to the next procurement milestone. Our initial list:

- Completed SIG spreadsheet (we prefer a control-by-control mapping to your SOC2/ISO controls)
- Copies of latest SOC 2 report and ISO 27001 certificate
- Key management / KMS attestation or proof of rotation policy
- Architecture diagram showing network boundaries and where customer data is processed
- Representative audit logs (redacted) for admin actions and KMS operations

Can you confirm what you can provide by May 28? We can accept a phased delivery — summary control mapping first, then artifacts. I'm copying Tom (security) and Procurement for timelines.

Attached: nova_rfp_reference.pdf (procurement excerpt)

Regards,
Sarah Coleman
Head of Procurement, NovaHealth

From: jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com

Subject: Fwd: Request: SIG questionnaire + evidence for NovaHealth POC

Team — forwarding NovaHealth's request (see below). They want a SIG + evidence by May 28, phased delivery ok. Proposed split of work:

- Neha: SOC 2 / ISO certs + high-level control mapping (matrix)
- Marcus: KMS / key rotation details and any HSM/KMS audit extracts
- Priyom: architecture diagram, runtime/EDR/audit log samples (redacted) and S3 share setup
- Monica: procurement/legal check for anything we can't share (NDAs / redactions) and any contract notes

Can everyone reply in-thread with ETA for their piece by EOD tomorrow so I can give NovaHealth a consolidated timeline. If anyone needs assistance with redaction or creating a short evidence manifest, ping me.

Thanks — Jasmine
Director, Solutions Engineering

Quick tech note — collecting the runtime/ops artifacts they asked for. A few clarifications:

1) When NovaHealth asks for "representative audit logs (redacted)", do they want admin/KMS audit entries only, or also runtime inference traces (we should not include PII or customer content)?
2) For KMS logs: we can provide KM service audit excerpts (key create/rotate/decrypt attempts) but will need to redact key IDs and any customer identifiers.

I've put together sample extracts: kv_cache_access_log_sample.txt (shows prefix cache access counts, fully redacted) and runtime-audit-trace.json (metadata-only events). I can stage a read-only S3 share for NovaHealth once Legal confirms the allowed set.

ETA: I can prep the staged share and sample artifacts by 2027-05-19 EOD. Marcus — can you confirm if KMS rotation policy doc is in the central vault or if I should pull from the infra repo?
